[[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]''Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children'' tells a continuous story with the next three ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Adventures]]'' books, and {{FactFile|12|ANA 1-4|Anakin Skywalker}} states that Anakin Skywalker was between the ages of 5 and 9 during the events of the books, giving a range of [[37 BBY/Legends|37]]–[[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''The Ghostling Children'' also depicts Anakin as older than the eight-year-old Arawynne, putting the books in 33 BBY. |series=''[[Star Wars: Episode I Adventures]]'' |preceded by=''[[Episode I Adventures 4: Jedi Emergency]]'' |followed by=''[[Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker]]'' }} '''''Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] junior novel written by [[Dave Wolverton]]. It is the fifth volume of the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Adventures]]'' series, and it was published by [[Scholastic]] in [[January]] [[2000]], with an accompanying gamebook. A sequel, [[Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker|''The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker'']], was published the [[February|following month]].
